skills.name: Like-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Common denominators
skills.definition: Rewrite unlike-denominator fractions as equivalent fractions with a common denominator before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract standard mixed numbers, whole numbers, or fractions without regrouping by separately handling whole-number and fractional parts.

skills.name: Mixed subtraction with regrouping
skills.definition: Borrow one whole into the fractional part when subtracting mixed numbers or fractions and the minuend's fractional part is too small.

skills.name: Whole-number minuend decomposition
skills.definition: Subtract a fraction or mixed number from a whole number by decomposing the whole number into whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert nonstandard mixed numbers with improper fractional components into standard mixed-number form before subtracting.
